purpose: Warn that an unwelcome possibility could become real.
keywords: Vます stem + かねない
That wording could lead to misunderstanding.
Driving while tired could cause an accident.
Skipping the checks could expose personal information.
A polite inability and an undesirable possibility
formation: Vます stem + かねない
restrictions: Normally predicts a negative or concerning outcome.
mistake: Do not confuse かねない “might” with かねる “cannot readily”.
